title: Sherlock 2.1 is here!
release_notes:
### 🌐 3,300+ Platforms OSINT (Maigret Engine)
• Upgraded engine covering 3,300+ international & specialized networks
• Full scan depth controls (All 3,300+ / Top 1,000 / Top 500 Alexa-ranked)
• Recursive search: discovers secondary IDs and expands queries automatically
• Android native DNS resolution: 100% domain connectivity via system resolver

### 📑 Multi-Format Intelligence Dossiers
• Gold PDF Dossier: printable reports with metadata & verified registry
• XMind Mind Map (.xmind): interactive visual graph case files
• Identity Network Analysis: interactive clustering & hub diagnostics
• Full data exports: JSON, standard CSV, and clean Plain Text lists

### ⚡ 6-Layer Performance Cache
• 2.88x faster cold start: pre-compiled binary database cache
• On-device avatar cache: 0ms offline image loading for verified profiles
• Pre-rendered dossier cache: instant 0ms report re-exports
• Inverted tag index: O(1) instant category & country filtering

### 🚀 Responsive UI & Mobile Hardening
• Zero UI lag: scanning engines isolated to background worker threads
• Instant cancel: process terminates and updates status in 0ms
• Alphabetical sorting (A-Z) across all results tabs
• Context-aware profile modals & compact MarkItDown appearance controls
